title: Fruit Rainbow Skewers
steps: Wash all the fruit well and let it dry.
Thread the fruit onto the skewers in a color pattern: red, yellow, green, purple.
Arrange on a plate and serve right away.
tips: No stove needed Ã¢â‚¬â€ a great first recipe to build knife-free confidence.

title: Fluffy Pancakes
steps: Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
In another bowl, mix milk, egg, and melted butter.
Pour wet ingredients into dry and stir until just combined (lumps are OK).
Heat a lightly buttered pan on medium. Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake.
Flip when bubbles form on top, cook 1-2 more minutes.
Serve warm with toppings you like.
tips: Ask an adult to help with the stove and flipping.

title: Rainbow Veggie Wrap
steps: Spread hummus evenly over each tortilla.
Layer the lettuce, carrots, and pepper strips down the middle.
Sprinkle sunflower seeds on top.
Fold in the sides, then roll tightly.
Slice in half and enjoy.
tips: A grown-up can pre-slice the pepper for younger chefs.

title: One-Pot Cheesy Pasta
steps: Add pasta, broth, and garlic powder to a big pot.
Bring to a boil, stirring often so pasta doesn't stick.
Simmer until pasta is tender and most liquid is absorbed, about 10 minutes.
Turn off heat, stir in milk and cheese until creamy.
Season with salt and pepper, then serve.
tips: Stovetop step needs adult supervision the whole time.

title: No-Bake Energy Bites
steps: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl until well combined.
Chill the mixture in the fridge for 10 minutes.
Roll into small balls using clean hands.
Store in the fridge in a sealed container.
tips: No cooking at all Ã¢â‚¬â€ perfect for a first solo recipe.

title: Homemade Guacamole
steps: Cut avocados in half, remove the pit, and scoop flesh into a bowl.
Mash with a fork to your favorite texture.
Stir in lime juice, onion, tomato, and cilantro.
Add salt to taste and serve with tortilla chips.
tips: Removing the pit is a job for an adult Ã¢â‚¬â€ the knife can slip.

title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Fajitas
steps: Preheat oven to 425Ã‚Â°F (220Ã‚Â°C).
Toss chicken, peppers, and onion with oil and seasoning on a sheet pan.
Spread in a single layer and roast 20-25 minutes, stirring once.
Check chicken is fully cooked (no pink, 165Ã‚Â°F/74Ã‚Â°C internal).
Warm tortillas and build your fajitas.
tips: Raw chicken needs an adult's help with safe handling and a thermometer check.

title: Classic Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 375Ã‚Â°F (190Ã‚Â°C).
Cream butter and both sugars until fluffy.
Beat in eggs one at a time.
Mix in flour and baking soda until just combined.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Scoop onto a baking sheet and bake 9-11 minutes until golden.
tips: Oven trays are hot Ã¢â‚¬â€ always use mitts and let an adult handle them going in and out.

title: Iced Fruit Tea
steps: Have an adult steep the tea bags in hot water for 5 minutes, then remove bags.
Stir in honey while warm, then let cool.
Pour over ice in glasses and add berries.
tips: The hot water step should always be handled by an adult.

title: Caprese Skewer Bites
steps: Thread a tomato, a folded basil leaf, and a mozzarella ball onto each skewer.
Arrange on a plate.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze before serving.
tips: A fun no-cook party appetizer to practice plating.

title: Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Heat oil in a large pan or wok over medium-high heat.
Add vegetables and cook 3-4 minutes.
Push veggies aside, pour in eggs, and scramble until set.
Add rice and soy sauce, stirring everything together for 4-5 minutes.
Top with green onions and serve.
tips: Hot oil can pop Ã¢â‚¬â€ keep a safe distance and have an adult nearby.

title: Banana Oat Muffins
steps: Preheat oven to 350Ã‚Â°F (175Ã‚Â°C) and line a muffin tin.
Mix mashed banana with melted butter.
Stir in sugar, egg, and vanilla.
Add baking soda and flour, mix until just combined.
Fold in oats.
Divide into muffin cups and bake 20-22 minutes.
tips: A great way to practice measuring and following steps in order.

title: DIY Pizza Night
steps: Preheat oven to 475Ã‚Â°F (245Ã‚Â°C).
Stretch dough onto a floured tray.
Spread sauce, then cheese, then your favorite toppings.
Bake 10-14 minutes until the crust is golden and cheese is bubbly.
Let cool 5 minutes before slicing.
tips: Sliding pizzas in and out of a hot oven is an adult's job.

title: Yogurt Parfait Jars
steps: Spoon a layer of yogurt into a jar.
Add a layer of granola, then berries.
Repeat layers until the jar is full.
Drizzle honey on top and serve.
tips: Perfect first recipe Ã¢â‚¬â€ no cooking or cutting required.

title: Baked Sweet Potato Fries
steps: Preheat oven to 425Ã‚Â°F (220Ã‚Â°C).
Toss sweet potato strips with oil and spices.
Spread in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Bake 20-25 minutes, flipping halfway, until crisp at the edges.
tips: Ask an adult to help cut the potatoes into even strips.

title: Classic Lemonade
steps: Stir lemon juice and sugar together until the sugar dissolves.
Add cold water and stir well.
Pour over ice and garnish with lemon slices.
tips: Juicing lemons is a great hand-strength building task for young chefs.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
ingredients: 4 bell peppers, tops cut and seeded
steps: Preheat oven to 375Ã‚Â°F (190Ã‚Â°C).
Mix cooked rice, turkey, half the sauce, and seasoning in a bowl.
Stuff the mixture into each pepper.
Place peppers in a baking dish, top with remaining sauce and cheese.
Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes, then uncover for 10 more.
tips: Cooking raw meat safely needs an adult's guidance every step.

title: Apple Nachos
steps: Arrange apple slices on a plate like nacho chips.
Drizzle melted peanut butter over the top.
Sprinkle granola, chocolate chips, and coconut over everything.
Serve right away.
tips: An adult can help with the thin apple slices.

title: Mini Veggie Frittatas
steps: Preheat oven to 350Ã‚Â°F (175Ã‚Â°C) and grease a muffin tin.
Whisk eggs and milk together.
Stir in vegetables and cheese.
Pour into muffin cups, filling about 3/4 full.
Bake 18-20 minutes until set and lightly golden.
tips: A good recipe for practicing oven timing and safety.

title: Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie
steps: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend on high until smooth, about 30-45 seconds.
Pour into glasses and serve immediately.
tips: Always keep hands clear of the blender blades Ã¢â‚¬â€ ask an adult to help with the lid.

title: Homemade Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: In a big pot, bring broth to a boil with chicken breast.
Simmer 15 minutes until chicken is cooked through, then remove and shred it.
Add carrots, celery, and onion to the pot, simmer 10 minutes.
Add noodles and shredded chicken, cook until noodles are tender.
Season with salt and pepper.
tips: Working with boiling broth and raw chicken means adult supervision throughout.

title: Trail Mix Bar
steps: Set out small bowls of each ingredient.
Scoop your favorite combo into a bag or bowl.
Mix and enjoy!
tips: A fun way to practice measuring cups with zero cooking involved.

title: Baked Salmon with Herbs
steps: Preheat oven to 400Ã‚Â°F (200Ã‚Â°C).
Place salmon on a lined baking sheet, drizzle with oil.
Top with garlic, herbs, salt, pepper, and lemon slices.
Bake 12-15 minutes until fish flakes easily with a fork.
tips: Checking fish is fully cooked is a job to do together with an adult.

title: Overnight Chia Pudding
steps: Whisk chia seeds, milk, maple syrup, and vanilla together in a jar.
Cover and refrigerate overnight, stirring once after 20 minutes.
Top with fresh fruit before serving.
tips: No cooking needed Ã¢â‚¬â€ great for practicing patience and planning ahead.

title: Spicy Garlic Sauce
steps: Mash or finely grate the garlic.
Stir garlic, mayonnaise or yogurt, lemon juice, hot sauce, honey, and salt together.
Taste and adjust with more lemon or hot sauce.
Chill 10 minutes before serving.
tips: Developer favorite sauce: bold, garlicky, spicy, and good on wraps, fries, bowls, and grilled food.

title: Fresh Chimichurri
steps: Finely chop parsley, oregano, and garlic.
Stir with vinegar, olive oil, chili flakes, and salt.
Rest 10 minutes so the flavors wake up.
tips: A bright herb sauce for steak, chicken, roasted vegetables, and sandwiches.

title: Basil Pesto
steps: Add basil, nuts, garlic, Parmesan, lemon, and salt to a blender.
Blend while drizzling in olive oil.
Taste and loosen with a little more oil if needed.
tips: Classic green sauce for pasta, pizza, toast, eggs, and vegetables.

title: Teriyaki Glaze
ingredients: 1 tsp cornstarch mixed with 1 tbsp water
steps: Simmer soy sauce, water, honey, vinegar, ginger, and garlic.
Stir in cornstarch slurry.
Cook 1-2 minutes until glossy and slightly thick.
tips: Use with tofu, chicken, salmon, rice bowls, and stir-fries.

title: Peanut Satay Sauce
steps: Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, lime, honey, ginger, and chili.
Add warm water a spoonful at a time until smooth.
Taste and balance salty, sweet, and sour.
tips: Creamy dipping sauce for skewers, noodles, vegetables, and wraps.

title: Tzatziki
steps: Squeeze water from grated cucumber.
Stir cucumber with yogurt, garlic, lemon, olive oil, herbs, and salt.
Chill before serving.
tips: Cool sauce for pita, grilled food, vegetables, and bowls.

title: Lebanese Toum
steps: Blend garlic and salt until very fine.
Slowly drizzle in oil while blending, alternating with lemon juice and ice water.
Stop when fluffy and white.
tips: Very garlicky and powerful. Add oil slowly so it stays creamy.

title: Harissa Yogurt Sauce
steps: Stir yogurt, harissa, lemon, honey, and salt.
Taste and add more harissa for more heat.
Serve cold.
tips: Spicy-creamy sauce for roasted vegetables, chicken, sandwiches, and grain bowls.

title: Salsa Roja
steps: Roast or pan-char tomatoes, onion, garlic, and jalapeno with adult help.
Blend with cilantro, lime, and salt.
Taste and adjust.
tips: Great for tacos, eggs, chips, bowls, and grilled food.

title: Spanish Romesco
steps: Blend pepper, almonds, garlic, tomato paste, vinegar, paprika, and salt.
Drizzle in olive oil until thick and smooth.
Taste and adjust vinegar or salt.
tips: Nutty red sauce for vegetables, fish, potatoes, and sandwiches.

title: Lemon Tahini Sauce
steps: Whisk tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and salt.
Add cold water slowly until creamy and pourable.
Taste and adjust.
tips: Perfect on falafel, salads, roasted vegetables, wraps, and bowls.

title: Thai Sweet Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1 tsp cornstarch mixed with 1 tbsp water
steps: Simmer water, vinegar, sugar, garlic, chili, and salt.
Stir in cornstarch slurry.
Cook until glossy and lightly thick.
tips: Sweet, tangy dipping sauce for spring rolls, nuggets, tofu, and noodles.

title: Smoky BBQ Sauce
steps: Add all ingredients to a small pot.
Simmer gently 10-15 minutes, stirring often.
Cool before using.
tips: Brush on grilled food or use as a dip for fries and roasted vegetables.

title: Creamy Ranch Sauce
steps: Stir everything together in a bowl.
Taste and add lemon or salt if needed.
Chill until ready to dip.
tips: Easy dip for vegetables, wraps, pizza crust, and chicken.

title: Coconut Curry Sauce
steps: Cook onion and garlic in oil until soft.
Stir in curry powder for 30 seconds.
Add coconut milk and tomato sauce, then simmer until smooth.
tips: A cozy sauce for rice, vegetables, chickpeas, chicken, or tofu.

title: Gochujang Sesame Sauce
steps: Whisk gochujang, soy sauce, vinegar, honey, sesame oil, and water.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Thin with extra water if needed.
tips: Spicy-sweet sauce for noodles, bowls, dumplings, and roasted vegetables.

title: Ponzu Citrus Sauce
steps: Whisk all ingredients together.
Taste and add more citrus if you like it bright.
Serve as a dip or drizzle.
tips: Light sauce for dumplings, noodles, fish, cucumbers, and rice bowls.

title: Miso Ginger Sauce
steps: Whisk miso, ginger, vinegar, honey, and sesame oil.
Add warm water until creamy.
Taste and adjust sweetness or tang.
tips: Savory sauce for salads, noodles, tofu, salmon, and vegetables.

title: Bechamel White Sauce
steps: Melt butter in a pot with adult help.
Whisk in flour for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in milk and cook until smooth and thick.
Season with nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
tips: Classic creamy sauce for pasta bakes, lasagna, vegetables, and gratins.

title: Chocolate Ganache Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup warm cream or coconut cream
steps: Place chocolate chips in a bowl.
Have an adult warm the cream until steamy, not boiling.
Pour cream over chocolate, wait 2 minutes, then stir smooth.
tips: Dessert magic sauce for fruit, pancakes, ice cream, cakes, and cookies.

title: Margherita Pizza
steps: Stretch dough thin.
Spread tomatoes and add mozzarella.
Bake in a very hot oven until crust is blistered.
Finish with basil, olive oil, and salt.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
steps: Boil pasta in salted water.
Crisp guanciale and reserve its fat.
Mix eggs, Pecorino, and pepper.
Toss hot pasta with guanciale, then off heat mix in egg mixture using pasta water for a glossy sauce.

title: Lasagna
steps: Make a meat ragÃƒÂ¹ with vegetables, beef, and tomato.
Prepare bÃƒÂ©chamel.
Layer ragÃƒÂ¹, pasta, bÃƒÂ©chamel, and cheese.
Bake until bubbling and browned, then rest before slicing.

title: Risotto alla Milanese
steps: Warm saffron in a little stock.
Soften onion in butter and toast rice.
Add hot stock a ladle at a time while stirring.
Add saffron near the end, then finish off heat with butter and Parmesan.

title: Minestrone
steps: SautÃƒÂ© chopped vegetables.
Add tomatoes, stock, potatoes, and beans and simmer until tender.
Add pasta and cook until al dente.
Season and serve with olive oil and Parmesan.

title: Bruschetta
steps: Toast bread.
Rub warm slices with garlic.
Top with chopped tomatoes and basil.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt.

title: Tiramisu
steps: Separate eggs.
Beat yolks with sugar and mascarpone; fold in whipped egg whites.
Dip ladyfingers briefly in coffee and layer with cream.
Chill several hours and dust with cocoa.

title: Panzanella
steps: Soak stale bread briefly and squeeze dry.
Chop vegetables and basil.
Toss everything with vinegar and olive oil.
Rest before serving so the flavors combine.

title: Tacos al Pastor
steps: Blend achiote, soaked chiles, garlic, vinegar, and spices.
Marinate pork.
Cook until browned and tender, adding pineapple near the end.
Chop and serve in warm tortillas with onion and cilantro.

title: Guacamole
steps: Mash avocado roughly.
Fold in tomato, onion, cilantro, and lime.
Season with salt and add jalapeÃƒÂ±o if desired.
Serve immediately.

title: Enchiladas
steps: Soften chiles and blend with garlic, onion, and water to make sauce.
Dip tortillas in sauce and fill with chicken.
Roll and place in a baking dish.
Cover with sauce and cheese and bake until hot.

title: Chilaquiles
steps: Warm salsa in a skillet.
Toss in tortilla chips briefly so they soften slightly but keep texture.
Top with fried eggs, crema, queso, onion, and cilantro.

title: Pozole
steps: Simmer pork with onion and garlic until tender.
Blend softened guajillos with garlic and add the chile sauce.
Add hominy and oregano and simmer.
Serve with cabbage, radish, lime, and onion.

title: Elote
steps: Grill corn until lightly charred.
Mix mayonnaise and crema.
Spread over warm corn.
Roll in cotija and finish with lime, chili, and cilantro.

title: Tres Leches Cake
steps: Bake a light sponge and cool it.
Pierce the cake all over.
Slowly pour over the three-milk mixture.
Chill, top with whipped cream, and dust with cinnamon.

title: Churros
steps: Boil water, butter, sugar, and salt.
Stir in flour until a dough forms.
Pipe strips into hot oil with adult supervision and fry until golden.
Drain and coat with cinnamon sugar.

title: Sushi Rolls
steps: Cook and season sushi rice with vinegar.
Place nori on a bamboo mat and spread rice thinly.
Add fillings and roll firmly.
Slice with a sharp wet knife and serve with soy sauce.

title: Ramen
steps: Prepare a seasoned broth.
Cook noodles separately and drain.
Add noodles to bowls with hot broth and toppings.
Finish with egg, scallions, and nori.

title: Tempura
steps: Prepare very cold batter without overmixing.
Coat seafood and vegetables lightly.
Fry in hot oil until crisp with adult help.
Drain and serve with dipping sauce.

title: Okonomiyaki
steps: Mix flour, dashi, and eggs, then fold in cabbage and scallions.
Cook the batter with pork or shrimp in a skillet.
Flip and cook through.
Top with sauce, mayonnaise, and bonito flakes.

title: Yakitori
steps: Cut chicken and scallions into bite-size pieces and skewer.
Simmer soy, mirin, sake, and sugar into tare.
Grill skewers, brushing with tare several times.
Cook chicken through and serve.

title: Miso Soup
steps: Warm dashi without boiling hard.
Dissolve miso in a little hot broth and return it to the pot.
Add tofu and wakame and warm gently.
Garnish with scallions.

title: Onigiri
steps: Cook rice and let it cool enough to handle.
Wet and salt your hands.
Form rice around a filling into a triangle or ball.
Wrap with nori and serve.

title: Mochi
steps: Mix rice flour, sugar, and water.
Steam or microwave until thick and translucent, stirring carefully.
Dust a surface with starch, divide the dough, and wrap small portions around red-bean filling.

title: Chicken Biryani
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt, spices, ginger, and garlic.
Part-cook basmati rice.
Layer chicken, rice, fried onion, saffron, and herbs.
Cover tightly and cook on low until rice and chicken are done.

title: Butter Chicken
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon, and spices.
Cook chicken until browned.
Simmer tomato, butter, ginger, and garlic into a sauce.
Add chicken, cream, and kasuri methi and simmer gently.

title: Chana Masala
steps: SautÃƒÂ© cumin and onion.
Add ginger-garlic and spices.
Add tomatoes and cook until thick.
Stir in chickpeas and water and simmer until the sauce coats them.
Finish with lemon and cilantro.

title: Samosas
steps: Make a firm flour dough.
Cook spiced potato and pea filling.
Roll dough, cut into rounds, and shape into cones.
Fill and seal, then fry until crisp with adult supervision.

title: Masala Dosa
steps: Soak rice, dal, and fenugreek, then grind and ferment the batter.
Cook spiced potato filling with onion and mustard seeds.
Spread batter thinly on a hot pan.
Add filling, fold, and serve with chutney and sambar.

title: Palak Paneer
steps: Blanch spinach and blend into a puree.
SautÃƒÂ© cumin, onion, ginger, and garlic, then add tomato and spices.
Stir in spinach and paneer and simmer gently.
Finish with a little cream.

title: Naan
steps: Mix flour, yeast, yogurt, water, salt, and sugar into a soft dough.
Let rise.
Divide and stretch into ovals.
Cook on a very hot skillet or oven surface and brush with ghee.

title: Gulab Jamun
steps: Make a soft dough from milk powder, flour, baking powder, ghee, and yogurt.
Shape small balls.
Fry gently until golden.
Soak warm balls in hot cardamom-rose syrup.

title: Pad Thai
steps: Soak noodles until pliable.
Mix tamarind, fish sauce, and palm sugar.
Stir-fry protein, then eggs.
Add noodles and sauce and toss until tender.
Fold in sprouts and serve with peanuts and lime.

title: Tom Yum
steps: Simmer lemongrass, galangal, and lime leaves in stock.
Add mushrooms and shrimp.
Season with fish sauce and chili.
Turn off heat and add lime juice and cilantro.

title: Green Curry
steps: Fry curry paste briefly in coconut cream.
Add chicken and remaining coconut milk.
Add eggplant and bamboo shoots and simmer until cooked.
Season with fish sauce and palm sugar and finish with basil.

title: Som Tam
steps: Pound garlic and chilies gently.
Add beans and tomatoes and bruise lightly.
Add lime, fish sauce, and palm sugar.
Shred papaya and toss everything together, then top with peanuts.

title: Satay
steps: Blend spices, lemongrass, coconut milk, fish sauce, and sugar into a marinade.
Marinate chicken and skewer.
Grill until cooked through.
Serve with peanut sauce and cucumber relish.

title: Mango Sticky Rice
steps: Steam sticky rice until tender.
Warm coconut milk with palm sugar and salt.
Mix most of it into the hot rice and rest to absorb.
Serve with sliced mango and remaining coconut sauce.

title: Pho
steps: Char onion and ginger.
Simmer beef bones with spices for a long, gentle broth and skim it.
Cook noodles and slice beef.
Assemble bowls with noodles, beef, and hot broth, then add herbs and lime.

title: Banh Mi
steps: Warm the baguette.
Spread mayonnaise and pÃƒÂ¢tÃƒÂ©.
Add cooked meat and pickled carrot-daikon.
Finish with cucumber, cilantro, and chili.

title: Fresh Spring Rolls
steps: Soften rice paper briefly in water.
Layer lettuce, noodles, herbs, cucumber, and shrimp.
Fold the sides and roll tightly.
Serve with hoisin-peanut dipping sauce.

title: Bun Cha
steps: Season pork with fish sauce, sugar, and garlic and form small patties.
Grill patties and pork belly until cooked and lightly charred.
Make a sweet-sour dipping broth.
Serve with noodles, herbs, and pickles.

title: Bibimbap
steps: Cook rice.
Season and sautÃƒÂ© vegetables separately.
Cook marinated beef.
Arrange rice with vegetables and beef in a bowl.
Add gochujang, sesame oil, and a fried egg and mix before eating.

title: Kimchi
steps: Salt cabbage until softened, then rinse and drain.
Mix garlic, ginger, gochugaru, fish sauce, and vegetables into a paste.
Coat cabbage and pack into a clean container.
Ferment at room temperature briefly, then refrigerate.

title: Bulgogi
steps: Blend pear, soy, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, and sugar.
Marinate beef.
Cook quickly in a hot pan or grill until browned.
Finish with scallions and sesame seeds.

title: Tteokbokki
steps: Simmer stock with gochujang, gochugaru, soy, and sugar.
Add rice cakes and fish cake.
Simmer until the sauce thickens and cakes become tender.
Finish with scallions.

title: Japchae
steps: Cook noodles and rinse.
Stir-fry beef and vegetables separately.
Toss everything with soy, sugar, sesame oil, and garlic.
Warm together and garnish with sesame seeds.

title: Kimchi Fried Rice
steps: SautÃƒÂ© chopped kimchi.
Add rice, kimchi juice, and gochujang and stir-fry until hot.
Finish with sesame oil and scallions.
Top with a fried egg.

title: Kung Pao Chicken
steps: Marinate diced chicken briefly.
Mix soy, vinegar, sugar, and starch into sauce.
Stir-fry chicken, then aromatics and chilies.
Return chicken with sauce and peanuts and toss until glossy.

title: Mapo Tofu
steps: Brown meat with doubanjiang, garlic, and ginger.
Add stock and tofu gently.
Simmer until flavors combine.
Season with soy and Sichuan pepper and finish with scallions.

title: Dumplings
steps: Mix pork with cabbage, ginger, scallions, soy, and sesame oil.
Fill wrappers and pleat edges.
Pan-fry the bottoms, add water, cover, and steam until cooked.
Serve with dipping sauce.

title: Fried Rice
steps: Scramble eggs in hot oil and remove.
Stir-fry vegetables, then add cold rice and break up clumps.
Return eggs and add soy sauce.
Finish with sesame oil and scallions.

title: Hot and Sour Soup
steps: Simmer stock with soy, bamboo shoots, and mushrooms.
Add meat or tofu.
Season with vinegar and white pepper.
Thicken lightly with starch slurry and slowly pour in beaten egg.

title: Char Siu
steps: Mix marinade and coat pork.
Refrigerate to marinate.
Roast while basting several times until caramelized and cooked through.
Rest before slicing.

title: Baklava
steps: Brush phyllo with melted butter and layer with chopped nuts.
Cut into diamonds.
Bake until crisp and golden.
Pour cooled syrup flavored with lemon and orange blossom over the hot baklava.

title: Hummus
steps: Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon, garlic, and salt.
Add cold water gradually until smooth.
Spread in a bowl, drizzle with olive oil, and serve.

title: Tabbouleh
steps: Rinse and soak bulgur briefly.
Finely chop parsley, mint, tomatoes, and onion.
Toss with bulgur, lemon juice, and olive oil.
Rest briefly before serving.

title: Fattoush
steps: Chop vegetables and herbs.
Toast pita pieces until crisp.
Whisk lemon, olive oil, and sumac.
Toss salad with dressing and add pita just before serving.

title: Kibbeh
steps: Soak bulgur and blend with meat, onion, and spices into a fine shell mixture.
Cook filling meat with onion and pine nuts.
Shape kibbeh shells, fill, seal, and bake or fry until cooked.

title: Shish Tawook
steps: Mix yogurt, garlic, lemon, spices, and oil.
Marinate chicken pieces.
Skewer and grill until browned and cooked through.
Serve with toum, salad, or pita.

title: Manakish
steps: Make a soft yeast dough and let it rise.
Divide and flatten into rounds.
Brush with olive oil and spread za'atar mixture.
Bake in a very hot oven until the edges are golden.

title: Lentil Soup
steps: Rinse lentils.
SautÃƒÂ© onion, then add vegetables, lentils, spices, and water.
Simmer until everything is soft.
Blend if desired and finish with lemon and olive oil.

title: Falafel
steps: Soak chickpeas overnight and drain.
Pulse with herbs, onion, garlic, and spices until coarse.
Mix in baking soda, shape into balls, and fry until crisp with adult supervision.

title: Shakshuka
steps: SautÃƒÂ© onion and pepper.
Add garlic, tomatoes, cumin, paprika, and chili and simmer into a thick sauce.
Make wells and crack in eggs.
Cover and cook until whites are set.

title: Couscous
steps: Cook meat with onion, tomatoes, and spices.
Add vegetables and broth and simmer until tender.
Steam or prepare couscous until fluffy.
Serve couscous topped with meat, vegetables, chickpeas, and broth.

title: Tagine
steps: Brown meat lightly with onion and spices.
Add a little water and cook covered until tender.
Add preserved lemon and olives near the end.
Finish with cilantro and serve with bread.

title: Harira
steps: Cook onion, celery, herbs, and spices.
Add tomatoes, lentils, chickpeas, and stock and simmer.
Add vermicelli.
Thicken with a flour-water mixture and simmer until smooth.

title: Pastilla
steps: Cook chicken with onion and Moroccan spices until tender.
Shred chicken and reduce the sauce, then add eggs to make a soft filling.
Layer pastry, chicken, egg, and sweet almonds.
Fold and bake until crisp; dust with sugar and cinnamon.

title: Moussaka
steps: Salt and roast eggplant slices.
Cook meat with onion, tomato, and cinnamon.
Layer eggplant and meat.
Cover with bÃƒÂ©chamel and cheese and bake until browned.

title: Greek Salad
steps: Cut vegetables into large pieces.
Add olives and feta.
Sprinkle oregano and drizzle generously with olive oil.
Toss gently and serve.

title: Souvlaki
steps: Marinate meat with oil, lemon, garlic, and oregano.
Thread onto skewers and grill until cooked.
Serve in pita with tomato, onion, and lemon.

title: Spanakopita
steps: Wilt spinach and squeeze out excess water.
Mix with feta, onion, dill, and egg.
Layer oiled phyllo with filling.
Fold and bake until crisp and golden.

title: Paella
steps: Sear meat or seafood and set aside as appropriate.
Cook tomato, beans, and paprika in the pan.
